package handlers

import (
	"net/http"

	httpmw "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

type StudentPositionHandler struct {
	Validator *validator.Validate
	Positions studentuc.PositionUseCase
}

func (handler StudentPositionHandler) ListStudentPositions(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(request.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}

	positionIDs, err := handler.Positions.ListStudentPositionIDs(request.Context(), studentID)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"position_ids": positionIDs,
	})
}

func (handler StudentPositionHandler) UpdateStudentPositions(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	var payload struct {
		PositionIDs []int `json:"position_ids"`
	}
	if err := decodeAndValidate(handler.Validator, request, &payload); err != nil {
		http.Error(responseWriter, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(request.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}

	positionIDs, err := handler.Positions.UpdateStudentPositionIDs(request.Context(), studentID, payload.PositionIDs)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"position_ids": positionIDs,
	})
}
